paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.24% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.73%) and Hang Seng weakest (-0.73%). Brent crude changed -1.68% to 111.97. Gold changed -0.50% to 4,054.3. Bitcoin changed -0.49% to 80,410.6016. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.02%, a relative move of +0.54%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (+12.48%) and Santander (-6.01%) moved the most.
